'''Uptown''' was a district of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Talaos City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. The [[Civil Defense Center]], [[Hutt Embassy]], and [[Hall of Records (Talaos City)|Hall of Records]] were located in Uptown.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uptown appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
